evidence_quote: In this review we discuss autoinflammatory diseases which arise from mutations in genes encoding components of the TNF signalling pathway.
note: Narrative review of TNFR signalling diseases; HA20 cases (including one AOSD patient with a TNFAIP3 variant) are cited only in passing, with no per-patient table.

evidence_quote: We previously described a 17-year-old Japanese boy with a TNFAIP3 mutation (Cys200Alafs*16) in the OTU domain of A20 (Fig. 1) who suffered from recurrent painful oral ulcers, epigastralgia, and a low-grade fever.
note: Close call: a review that re-describes the authors' own previously reported HA20 patient with individual genotype, phenotype and an original immunoblot figure.
